title: The Squad: Team Management
shortDescription: Team schedules, rosters, scores and chat for coaches, athletes and families.
fullDescription:
Bring your team schedule and conversations into one place with The Squad. Coaches, athletes and families can find team information, follow updates and stay connected throughout the sports season.

PLAN AROUND YOUR TEAM
See upcoming games, practices and team events. Check the schedule before you leave and keep track of what is next.

FIND YOUR PEOPLE
Access team rosters and player information through your team account. Your coach or administrator manages membership and the roles available to you.

FOLLOW THE SEASON
View scores and team updates. Keep team conversations together so information is easier to find.

GET STARTED
Create a free account or sign in with the account you already use. Follow your team invitation and choose the correct team. Features depend on your role, team membership and plan, and can differ between the Android app and the web app.

The Squad is a sports team management companion for coaches, athletes and families. An internet connection is required. Free accounts and paid plans are available; any subscription offered on your platform shows its price and billing period before purchase. Team dues and event fees are separate from a software subscription.

Need help? Visit https://www.thesquad.pro/how-to or email team@thesquad.pro.
